description: This Java source file defines the 'EventSendNotAllowedException' class, a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto framework to indicate that an event cannot be sent due to lack of permissions or non-existence of the target 'Thing'. The class includes constructors, static factory methods, and a builder for creating immutable exception instances, along with serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: EventSendNotAllowedException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException that represents an exception thrown when an event send operation is not allowed due to permissions or existence issues.
